_readme: Source of truth for the prop library. `fit` is the real-world size in millimetres along one axis of the final Y-up model ('max' = longest side). `anchor` says where the origin sits: floor (base at y=0), ceiling (top at y=0), wall (back face at z=0, faces +z), wall-floor, or center. `scenes` lists room scenes that may use the prop; `category` groups the picker. Sizes marked in `sizeNote` are estimates, not manufacturer data. `exclude` lists object-name fragments deleted on import (ground discs, floor slabs). `material` overrides image-free materials: color [r,g,b] 0-1, roughness, metallic, alpha, emissive, emissiveStrength. `license` and `attribution` default to 'unconfirmed' / null and are copied into assets/props/index.json; fill them in per prop as terms are verified. `budget` caps a prop's triangle count: the converter simplifies anything above it, which matters because the photogrammetry sources run to hundreds of thousands of triangles each. `textureSize` overrides the library default per prop.
